snippet.title: The Island of Dr. Brain - game Loop Demo (MT-32 music) PC MS-DOS, 1992
snippet.description:
The Island of Dr. Brain  - loop demo with Roland MT-32 music.
1992, PC, MS-DOS.
Developed and published by Sierra-OnLine.
Recorded with Dosbox.
Music  recorded from a genuine Roland MT-32 module (rev.1 old)
Digitalized sounds effects recorded on the dosbox internal emulated soundblaster.
